---
name: Create Social Campaign
description: Produce a source-verified, platform-specific campaign draft and assets for human review.
agent: Social Campaign Creator
argument-hint: Provide topic, campaign goal, audience, platforms, tone, destinations, and timing.
---

Create a ready-to-review campaign using the approved research and `social_campaign_agent/` assets.

1. Confirm campaign goal, audience, platforms, destination identity, language, tone, dates/timezone, and CTA. If destination or timing is missing, draft only and mark it `NEEDS REVIEW`.
2. Verify scientific and medical statements with primary or official sources. Include source links and dates; state study stage and limitations. Health copy is educational and must not imply a treatment, diagnosis, or individual prognosis.
3. Create platform-specific captions and original/authorized creative guidance. Include sources, image alt text, on-screen text/captions for video, CTA, and appropriate health disclaimer. Do not claim a video was produced unless an actual media file was generated and inspected.
4. State capability accurately: Facebook Page photo/Reels and Instagram poster/Reels have bundled code; LinkedIn member publishing has bundled local confirmation; WhatsApp sending is not implemented and may only be handed off as a draft.
5. Run only the relevant mock tests. Do not call platform APIs, dispatch publishing workflows, publish, schedule, or send messages in this task.
6. Present exact text, asset, destination, audience, timing, and sources for separate approval before any later publication action.
